option.fly-speed-modifier.max_speed.tool: Upper bound for the temporary flight speed multiplier. The slider is non-linear: low values have finer control, high values move faster. Allowed range: 1.00x to 20.00x.
option.fly-speed-modifier.min_speed.tool: Lower bound for the temporary flight speed multiplier. Allowed range: 0.00x to 1.00x.
option.fly-speed-modifier.scroll_step.to: Controls how many non-linear multiplier adjustment operations are applied per mouse-wheel unit. Values are limited to one decimal place. Allowed range: 0.1 to 2.0.
